observations: The page number «( 5 )» stands at the head of the page, centred. The page has no footnotes and no signature.

L02: «alius .numerus»: a point stands before «numerus», at the base line, 5 px from the n and 14 px after «alius», of the size and form of the points of the line (8 by 8 px); no numeral follows it. Transcribed as printed; see the critical note.

L04-L05: the number of the example, «.ccc.» at the end of L04 and «xxv.» at the beginning of L05, without an opening point: 325, with five in the first place, twenty in the second and three hundred in the third (L07-L08). L12: its figure is printed «.335.», in old-style arabic numerals; see the critical note.
L23: the vertical bar between «decem,» and «fiat» marks the beginning of fol. 103 verso of the manuscript, which the note in the right margin, «car. 103 verso.», names; transcribed as a margin note.
L32: «posuistis», the second person plural, beside the singular «ueneris» (L31-L32), «fecisti» and «iunge» (L33); transcribed as printed, without a note of the editor.

Colons and semicolons: L20 «insimul:», L24 «rentia:» and L25 «ei:» are printed colons; a reader has added in pencil a tail below the lower dot of each, which makes them look like semicolons. The tails are much lighter than the print (their darkest pixel 87 to 143, where the tail of a printed semicolon, as in «prima;» of L10, has its darkest pixel at 20 to 66) and thinner. The semicolons of L07, L10 and L12 are printed.

Spaces at punctuation (rule of tools/punct.py: after a mark, a space where the gap is at least 12 px or two thirds of the median word space of the line; before a mark, where it is at least 10 px): without a space after the mark, L09 «sua,idest» (7 px, the median word space 13 px), L19 «differentia,ad» (5 px), L23 «decem,|fiat», L27 «unitatum,habueris» (5 px) and «.x.,fac» (8 px), L28 «differentia.In» (10 px, median 16), L29 «diximus,ut» (7 px), L33 «.x.,aliquem» (10 px, median 17) and «illo.Et» (10 px); with a space before the mark, L12 «.335. :» (11 px). In L26, set tightly (median 10.5 px), «differentiam. Verbi» (8 px) and «gratia. Si» (9 px) have a space; L29 «ostendatur due» is separated by 10 px.
copy_matter: A reader's notes in pencil: L01, «sic» underlined, and «significat» in the right margin beside the line, a gloss of «sic»; L02, a stroke over «qui»; L04, a curve through the «m» of «exemplari»; L12, a stroke under the middle figure of «.335.», and «325» in the right margin; L20, L24 and L25, tails added below the colons of «insimul:», «rentia:» and «ei:». Not part of the edition.

critical_notes.evidence: a point of the size and form of the points of the line stands before «numerus», set close to it; the sentence has no numeral there («Similiter si fuerit cum .c. alius numerus de his qui sunt infra eum»), and the parallel sentence of p. 4 has «aliquis numerus de his qui sunt infra eum» without a point (frame 010, L28-L29)
critical_notes.impact: none: the words read the same

critical_notes.evidence: the figure of the example is printed .335., where the number of the example is .ccc. xxv. (L04-L05), placed as five in the first place, twenty in the second and three hundred in the third (L06-L08), which is 325; a reader of this copy has underlined the middle figure and written «325» in the margin
critical_notes.impact: the figure of the example reads 325; whether the error is of the edition or of the manuscript is not shown by the print
